text:
maria: Quick heads-up — NovusHealth QBR scheduled Tue 3/19. We need a tight cost-focused deck: 90/180d spend trend, top 3 cost drivers, and 3 tactical recommendations (batching, KV cache, quantization). @derek @ana please.

derek: On it. I'll extract model-level token burn + QPS. How do you want normalization? per-session or per-user?

ana: Use per-API-key daily avg and 95th pct for spikes. I'll prepare budget alert history and a runway projection (3 scenarios).

priya: For enablement: propose a 45-min ops workshop that walks through prompt templates + batching knobs and an ops playbook. Wed afternoon works for me.

maria: Good. Also want a simple modelling slide showing KV prefix cache impact (estimate 10–30% token reduction). Can we show median and tail?

derek: Quick back-of-envelope from logs: KV cache + batching -> ~22% median token reduction, ~28% for high-dup flows. I'll turn this into a small table and a before/after token curve.

ana: Financial ask: 3 scenarios (conservative/base/optimistic) with cost per 100k effective tokens and monthly commit delta. Using current mix: gen ~70%, embed ~30%.

maria: Note renewal risk: customer hit budget alerts 3x in last 60d and raised latency tickets. Flagging as high risk unless we can demonstrate >=15% cost reduction + SLA remediation plan.

derek: Action items for me: produce model/token table, token reductions per route, and a short `recommendations.md` style bullet list. ETA EOD today.

priya: I'll draft the enablement slides + workshop runbook and a one-pager ops checklist for the customer.

ana: I'll add a "billing impact" slide with $/100k numbers and set up a demo budget alert flow. For demo threshold do we use $12k (customer commit $15k) or something else? @maria

maria: Use $12k/mo as the demo alert threshold. Also schedule a 30m sync with account team Mon 9am PT to review deck before QBR. @derek @priya

derek: ack. I'll also post raw kernel/latency traces in #eng-runtime if the team wants to validate the batch/quantization assumptions.

priya: Can someone confirm the top three API routes by token consumption? I have session IDs but need route mapping to prioritize prompts.

ana: From billing extracts: `/generate-chat`, `/batch-embed`, `/r2-rewrite` are the top three by token volume.

maria: Perfect. If we can show ~20% cost reduction in the base case and a concrete enablement plan, we should move renewal from red -> green. :crossed_fingers:

cost-alert-bot: Alert: NovusHealth exceeded 80% of monthly commit (threshold $12k) — triggered 2026-03-05T18:12:03Z.

maria: Thanks all. Recap of deliverables: derek -> model/token table + reductions (EOD), ana -> 3 financial scenarios + alert history (EOD), priya -> enablement deck + ops one-pager (tomorrow AM). Sync Mon 9am PT to finalize.
